items.summary: Migrate the accepted prototype into apps/desktop without replacing real runtime integrations.
Connect conversation, history, memory/privacy, controls, provider settings and Developer Mode to real typed Host/Gateway/Runtime contracts.
Complete signing, updates, N-1 migration, rollback, SBOM, canary, target-hardware performance and Beta gates.
The current system Python environment lacks fastapi; pytest collection found 394 tests but failed on conversation gateway and desktop contract imports.
Expose capability-based provider/model choices, existing credential migration and custom compatible endpoints without hardcoding DeepSeek Chat.
Back Developer Mode with typed snapshots, events, correlation IDs, capabilities and audited commands; no arbitrary shell, SQL, Python or eval.
Provision and benchmark a production vector backend; adapters and tests exist but deployment topology is environment-specific.
Calibrate extractor, recall, planner, surface, lifecycle, persona, affect and relationship thresholds on consented Beta traces.
Deploy content distribution/editorial services and author signed production content packs.
Confirm and catalog standalone current WorldOps, Text Runtime, Gateway and Model Provider Feishu design URLs where the repository currently has only local canonical docs or historical links.
Implement the intentionally deferred Recall trace retention linkage with Module 08 forgetting/lifecycle policy.
Desktop perception, vision, voice and always-on visual presence remain outside the text-first release.
